about: flybrain_models.pursuit_benchmark output; regenerate with `uv run python -m flybrain_models.pursuit_benchmark`

key_numbers_doc.models: connectome = mirror-averaged PursuitCircuit with the fitted k_out at arousal 1; connectome_raw = the same without mirror averaging; rewired / random = mean over 5 / 3 control seeds; no_AOTU019 / no_AOTU025 = that type silenced; AOTU019_excitatory = AOTU019 sign flipped to +1; arousal_0 = connectome at arousal 0; all with the connectome's k_out, none refitted. proportional and bang_bang = baselines. Every model has one fitted scalar
key_numbers_doc.idle_turn_deg_s: |turn rate| after 2 s with no target reported (after the 90 deg/s limit)
key_numbers_doc.loss: the fitting loss on held-out data: mae_deg + 1.0 * idle_turn_deg_s
key_numbers_doc.mae_deg: time-weighted mean |bearing error| (deg) over all held-out episodes (the fitting loss, on held-out data)
key_numbers_doc.within10: fraction of time with |bearing error| <= 10 deg
key_numbers_doc.in_view: fraction of time with the target inside the field of view
key_numbers_doc.step_settle_s_median: median time after a step or appearance until |error| stays <= 5 deg (episodes that never settle excluded; see step_settled_fraction)
key_numbers_doc.step_settled_fraction: fraction of steps and appearances that settle
key_numbers_doc.step_overshoot_deg_mean: mean largest error past the target after a step or appearance
key_numbers_doc.by_setting: the same metrics per field-of-view setting (+-30, +-60, +-100 deg)
key_numbers_doc.mae_deg_{step,appear,sine,walk,pass}: MAE per target track, all settings
key_numbers_doc.antisymmetry_error_deg_s: steering curve: mean |turn(az) + turn(-az)| over the sampled azimuths -150..150 deg

protocol.rig: ASSUMED: 15 Hz frames, 100 ms delay, 2 deg Gaussian noise, field of view +-30, +-60 and +-100 deg (+-100 = head camera +-30 on a neck panning about +-70; the head loop is not simulated), 5 % dropouts, 90 deg/s turn limit, 150 ms first-order lag
protocol.tracks: steps of 0.35/0.65/0.9 of the half field of view both ways; at +-100 also appearances at 60-95 deg; sinusoids 0.05-0.25 Hz, 15-40 deg (40-90 at +-100); OU random walks (tau 1 s, sd 30 deg/s); passes at 60-100 and 120-180 deg/s, 120 deg from straight ahead (+-30, +-60) or from 90 deg on one side to 90 deg on the other (+-100)
protocol.steering_curve: turn command after holding a target at each azimuth for 1 s, open loop, from rest; rewired/random averaged over seeds
